host: European Innovation Council (EIC) under the Horizon Europe Widening Participation and Strengthening the European Research Area (WIDERA) programme
summary: The EIC Pre-Accelerator aims to boost the innovation potential of early-stage deep-tech startups established in widening countries by enhancing business readiness, investor readiness, and technology maturation. It provides grants to support market readiness activities, investor preparation, technology scaling, and preparation for the EIC Accelerator Fast Track.
activity_types: Market readiness activities (business case development, growth planning, certification)
Investor readiness preparation (IP protection, revenue modelling)
Preparation for EIC Accelerator Fast Track
reporting_requirements: Lump sum funding with periodic reporting per Horizon Europe rules
Compliance with eligibility and financial capacity requirements described in General Annexes of Horizon Europe
